service_name.description: The service name identifier used by GRAM for this job manager instance.

service_description.default: Grid Engine Job Manager for Globus GRAM
service_description.description: A human-readable description of this job manager service.

queue.description: The default Grid Engine queue to which jobs will be submitted.

qsub_path.description: Absolute path to the Grid Engine qsub command.

qstat_path.description: Absolute path to the Grid Engine qstat command.

qdel_path.description: Absolute path to the Grid Engine qdel command.

qacct_path.description: Absolute path to the Grid Engine qacct command for job accounting.

max_jobs.description: Maximum number of jobs that this manager will handle concurrently.

work_dir.description: Directory used for temporary job staging and state files. Must be owned by the globus user.

notify_enabled.description: Whether to send email notifications on job completion or failure.

notify_email.description: Email address to receive job status notifications (only used if notify_enabled is true).

environment_vars.description: List of environment variables to inject into every Grid Engine job.

project.description: Grid Engine accounting project name (e.g., for billing or quota). Leave empty to omit.

resource_limits.description: List of default Grid Engine resource limits to apply to jobs (e.g., h_vmem, h_rt).

name.description: Name of the resource limit (e.g., h_vmem, h_rt).

admin_user.description: System user with permissions to run Grid Engine admin commands (e.g., qmod, qconf).

monitoring_enabled.description: Whether to enable real-time cluster resource monitoring via qhost.

qhost_path.description: Absolute path to the Grid Engine qhost command (only used if monitoring_enabled is true).
